_meta.purpose: Authorship. The brief asked for authorship as a reader-trust device; a fabricated reviewer is a liability, so this file carries what is true and leaves the rest null pending Q-10.
_meta.rule: If a person row has consent=false or credentials=null, the build renders no bio for them and no 'expert reviewed' badge anywhere.

site_team.name: Counter Tested
site_team.who_we_are: A small publishing operation that writes buying questions and publishes its own verification paperwork. We have not tested any of the five products on this shelf, and we say so on every page.
what_we_can_claim: we read the programme rules and the FTC guidance and built the site to them
we state the source of every number we print, and leave the rest blank
what_we_cannot_claim: that Amazon endorses us (it does not; the agreement forbids implying it)
